_comment: The claim register (C-06). Each entry is a published sentence, the command that enforces it, and the document it lives in. tools/check-claims.mjs fails if a sentence disappears (the claim was rewritten or lost), if its owner is not a file in this repo, or if the owner runs in no CI lane. Counts are NOT stored here — stamp.mjs owns every number, and a register that carried one would be the hand-written count this file exists to prevent. CHANGELOG.md is deliberately not a claim-bearing document: it is a dated record of past states.

claims.sentence: Body text meets **4.5:1**, borders / focus rings / control edges **3:1**, in both themes —
claims.threshold: TEXT_MIN 4.5 / CONTROL_MIN 3.0 over SURFACES

claims.sentence: the legend previews it. Every series clears **3:1** against every surface it can be drawn on, in
claims.threshold: SERIES_MIN 3.0 for 8 series x 6 surfaces, both themes

claims.sentence: State is never colour alone; every chart series carries a dash pattern as well as a hue.
claims.threshold: legend key must preview the series' own dash or solid paint

claims.sentence: text_contrast: "4.5:1"
claims.threshold: TEXT_MIN 4.5

claims.sentence: and every series clears 3:1 against every surface it can be
claims.threshold: the sentence beside the chart — the one a reader actually sees

claims.sentence: zero runtime dependencies, no build
claims.threshold: src/ imports nothing outside the repo; package.json declares no dependencies

claims.sentence: `prefers-reduced-motion: reduce` collapses every transition
claims.threshold: a reduce block in src/css collapses transition-duration and iteration-count

claims.sentence: not the mechanism WCAG 2.2.2 asks for
claims.threshold: every infinite animation is pausable and a control ships on a page

claims.sentence: re-tints every primary surface
claims.threshold: a root --brand-hue re-point must move a freshly mounted .c-btn--primary

claims.sentence: The pattern is a def the host inlines
claims.threshold: every url(#id) in src/css resolves to a def inside src/, with a fallback on a paint

claims.sentence: Which sheets, and in what order, is not typed here:
claims.threshold: rule E: README's bundler list must equal ds.css's @import list in name and order, and no document may restate its length

claims.sentence: and the gridline band is **derived** from `--chart-ticks` — one band per value
claims.threshold: re-pointing --chart-ticks must move the rendered band by 100/(ticks-1)

claims.sentence: A browser without it does not fail gracefully, and the reason is worth stating
claims.threshold: --check regenerates the fallback and fails if the committed bytes differ

claims.sentence: <!-- ds:components-line -->
claims.threshold: the published component and token counts are computed from src/, never typed

claims.sentence: Every chart carries an accessible name that says what it plots, and a text alternative held in a **sibling** of the named image, never a descendant of it
claims.threshold: no generic name ("Chart"), and a non-empty AX description on the image node, on every shipped page

claims.sentence: named image, not inside it: `role="img"` is a leaf role, so a description nested in
claims.threshold: the data alternative must not be a descendant of the named image

claims.sentence: they gap by different tokens, so an alias between them would silently restyle every use
claims.threshold: GAP_CONTRACT pins --space-stack/--space-sm and --space-2xs/--space-sm

claims.sentence: `.stack` and `.c-stack` are NOT the same rule
claims.threshold: the ratchet plus the gap contract; the ledger may only shrink

claims.sentence: A status message is announced from a live region that exists, empty, before anything is said
claims.threshold: host present at load wearing role=status and aria-live=polite and holding no text; a fired toast lands inside it and carries no role of its own; exactly one host afterwards; no live region pre-filled

claims.sentence: A status message is announced from a live region that exists, empty, before anything is said
claims.threshold: the same live-host assertions as C-28-a, measured in the guide's loaded document

claims.sentence: While a snippet disclosure is open the rest of the page leaves the tab order, and closing it releases every inert subtree
claims.threshold: the same tab-order and scroll-padding assertions as C-29-a

claims.sentence: While a snippet disclosure is open the rest of the page leaves the tab order, and closing it releases every inert subtree
claims.threshold: no focusable outside the open example stays reachable; the example itself is never inert; the rail is inert; zero inert attributes survive close; scroll-padding-block-start clears the measured header height

claims.sentence: The spatial family as one surface rather than nine specimens: the shell, a canvas the consumer owns, the chrome the system owns, and the readouts that carry their own provenance
claims.threshold: the family is read from [data-spatial-workspace] in the guide and every block it names must be rendered by at least one template; an empty family fails

claims.sentence: Digits are not quality
claims.threshold: each [data-ladder] row is recomputed from 111.32 km / 10^dp and must agree within 1%; data-precision must equal the decimals printed; a lon-then-lat order badge is required (RFC 7946 §3.1.1, §3.1.10)

claims.sentence: the attribution band owns its corner through tokens, reserves the mark's shipped box and never restyles it
claims.threshold: band inset/gap must equal --map-attribution-* through computed style, the mark slot must reserve 65x20, filter must be none, at least three text links, and the band must be visible

claims.sentence: refuses a block that appears in this specimen and in no template
claims.threshold: family discovered from [data-spatial-workspace]; every block must be rendered by at least one of templates/*.html; empty family or empty surface list fails

claims.sentence: A classified ramp names its breaks and its denominator, so a count is never presented as a density
claims.threshold: every .c-legend[data-classification] needs a non-empty .c-legend__method naming the scheme and a .c-legend__norm stating a denominator; 3-7 classes; empty population fails

claims.sentence: The token layer as a **DTCG 2025.10 Format** document
claims.threshold: dist/contour.tokens.json is validated by an independent implementation of the spec: zero errors, no $type outside the spec's vocabulary, the document is not read as a resolver document, the validator's own token count equals the artifact's, and every published colour is confirmed identical to the declaration it came from through that same implementation. Claims export only — never that a design tool reads it back

claims.sentence: named in a ledger with its reason instead of dropped
claims.threshold: exported + ledgered must equal the census exactly, with no token on both sides and none on neither; every ledger reason must be one the exporter defines; the ledgered count must equal the tokens it lists; the shipped bytes must equal a fresh derivation from src/css, so a hand-edited dist/ fails

claims.sentence: as a **DTCG 2025.10 Resolver** document
claims.threshold: dist/contour.themes.json must be recognized as documentType "resolver", declare version 2025.10 and a non-empty resolutionOrder, validate with zero errors, and carry the dark branch of every declared light-dark() pair; the base document must not contain the pair object the Format Module does not define

claims.sentence: The **component contract**: every block in `src/css` with its elements, variants and the states its selectors actually carry
claims.threshold: reads dist/contour.components.json and fails unless the block set equals the inventory's in both directions, every published count equals the arrays it summarizes, every element and variant folds back to the block that lists it, every claimed state appears in a src/css selector with comments stripped as the inventory strips them, every named sheet is a real file, and the shipped bytes equal a fresh derivation. Asserts the population it swept; a contract listing no blocks is a failure, not a pass

claims.sentence: listed per block but deliberately absent from the token→block index
claims.threshold: each property a block reads must land in exactly one of three buckets, and the three must reconstruct the inventory's raw read list; `tokens` must be declared in the census and `vars` defined by some src/css sheet, while `inputs` must be neither; the index must agree with the per-block lists in both directions and contain no `input`, so a property the stylesheet never defines cannot be published as a retunable lever

claims.sentence: Every sentence in it is the guide's own prose quoted from its DOM and every count is read from the inventory
claims.threshold: every paragraph under a doc's "What the guide says" must be a substring of the guide's own text with its tags removed, using the one reduction measured to reproduce the DOM; the gate prints how many paragraphs it compared and fails when that is zero, so a sweep that matched nothing cannot pass as a clean report

claims.sentence: publishes the blocks that no section documents rather than dropping them
claims.threshold: coverage.namedBySections + coverage.notNamedByAnySection must equal coverage.contractBlocks, which must equal the shipped contract's block count; the gap list must be exactly the contract blocks no doc names, so the set cannot grow quietly and a block cannot be both documented and listed as missing

claims.sentence: or if the package grew a URL, a tag or a CSS declaration
claims.threshold: the package is scanned for a URL scheme, a www. host, a mail address, markup, a class or style attribute, a CSS declaration or rule block, an assets/ path and an SVG reference — shapes measured at zero occurrences on the shipped bytes, so the rule is exact rather than loosened until it passes; the project is private until v1.0, and docs/ is prose, not a copy of the specimen layer

claims.sentence: carries the token census as the table `node tools/stamp.mjs` already computes (taken from stamp, never recomputed here)
claims.threshold: the shipped table must equal what stamp's read-only --json path computes today, its Total row must equal the inventory's unique/read/unread counts, and its group rows must sum to that Total; proven independent of the byte-equality backstop by mutating the emitter, where the byte rule is silent by construction and only the arithmetic fires

claims.sentence: dates itself from git rather than from the build
claims.threshold: index.lastUpdated must equal `git log -1 --format=%cI -- index.html` recomputed by the gate, and every section file must carry that same date; null is permitted for a tarball with no history, an invented date is not

claims.sentence: Conformance is answered by an independent implementation (ajv) against the pinned shadcn schemas vendored under `tools/audit/schema/`
claims.threshold: ajv validates every shipped document (registry.json plus each item file) against the vendored draft-07 schemas with strict mode on; the vendored bytes must still match the sha256 recorded in sources.json; ajv's own count of items must equal the index's; and the gate first feeds itself documents that MUST be rejected — an unknown type, a root with neither items nor include, a registry:file entry with no target, a style key on a non-base item — and fails if its validator accepts any of them, because a relaxation never tested is indistinguishable from a disabled gate. Exits rather than skipping when ajv is absent

claims.sentence: **Pointers, not copies** — inlining the stylesheets would duplicate bytes this package already ships
claims.threshold: no files[] entry may carry `content`, and no item may carry it either; every `files[].path` must resolve inside dist/ and be relative, never absolute and never escaping with `..`. The registry's own byte total is budgeted, so a switch to inlined CSS is a budget failure as well as a gate failure

claims.sentence: there is no `homepage` and no `url` field, because the project is private until v1.0
claims.threshold: registry.json must carry neither key, and the only URLs permitted anywhere in the document are the two $schema identifiers; every item's registryDependencies must be empty, proven against the shipped CSS — the core bundle's selectors must appear in each surface bundle, so the shared layer really is inside it and a host installing two surfaces is not told to install the base twice

claims.sentence: Machine-readable constraints for an agent generating UI with Contour: each rule names the gate that enforces it
claims.threshold: every cited gate must exist on disk AND be invoked by a CI job, and the job set the artifact publishes is recomputed from ci.yml and compared — never trusted from the emitter, because build and guard share the same library, so a wrong job label survives byte-equality and only an independent re-read catches it. Falsified 10/10: emitter refusing a phantom gate and a gate no job runs; guard catching a wrong job set with the byte rule silent by design, a hand-edit, a malformed file reported as invalid JSON rather than a stack trace, a URL, a restated owned count, and an empty rulebook; plus WCAG 2.2.2 and HTTP 404 staying green because they are identifiers, not tallies

claims.sentence: the agent-rules artifact cites only gates that exist and run in CI
claims.threshold: the emitter throws at build time, so no artifact with a dangling or unwired enforcement can be written at all — the guard is the backstop for a hand-edited file, not the first line. This clause exists because the row's own premise was false: it called three gates the proof, and reading their assertion loops found one owned no colour literal at all and the other ran in no CI lane while scanning whichever repo it was hard-coded to, not the one it stood in

claims.sentence: the layout reflows to 200 % zoom and to a 390 px viewport with no horizontal page scroll
claims.threshold: scrollWidth <= clientWidth per asserted width, both themes, JS off; a .c-table without .c-table-wrap fails; overflow-x reported so a mask is not read as reflow

claims.sentence: the layout reflows to 200% zoom and to a 390 px viewport with no horizontal
claims.threshold: same lane, run against every shipped page

claims.sentence: 4 external scripts (highlight.js from a CDN, `ds.js`, `wc/index.mjs`, `guide.js`)
claims.threshold: the same re-derivation as README's copy of the sentence, because the gate now walks every document that publishes the figure rather than the one that happened to be right; this sentence replaced a published `20+ external scripts` that no tool ever counted, and the `587 kB` beside it was deleted rather than restamped, since nothing measures the guide's byte size and a hand-copied figure is how the first number went wrong

claims.sentence: 4 external scripts (highlight.js from a CDN, `ds.js`, `wc/index.mjs`, `guide.js`)
claims.threshold: the stated figure, the number of names written beside it and that list's CDN subset are each re-derived from the fetched <script src> set of every shipped page, so the sentence is compared against the pages rather than repeated by the gate; an origin named in the allowlist that no page any longer loads is refused too, because a permission left behind after its dependency is gone approves the next one without anyone choosing it. Falsified 5/5 in a scratch tree, each mutation printing its own byte delta: an uninvited origin in a template, the allowlisted dependency deleted while its allowance stayed, the published figure moved off the measured one, the sentence left naming fewer scripts than it counts, and a CDN claim added to a script the page loads from disk
